reason: Both conversations correctly reached the broken door catch diagnosis, justified the part with a model-number requirement, and neither made unsupported claims or suggested bypassing the switch. Conversation 1 had a stronger opener (asked about the door click straight away) and sensibly told the owner to unplug before inspecting, but it padded the exchange with an irrelevant 'runs but doesn't heat' panel, repeated the same 'find the model number' message several times, and when the owner said the sticker was unreadable it simply restated that the number was critical rather than offering practical next steps. Conversation 2 was more efficient, confirmed the microswitch explanation once the snapped tongue was found, and responded to the missing sticker with concrete alternative locations (back panel, hidden flap), so it served the homeowner marginally better.
